sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
There is no way to find an item by text. `list` filters by status, tree and pass only.
The TUI has no search, no filter and no jump-to-id — its left pane is always the whole
queue. Nothing greps titles, findings or section bodies. The workaround is running your
own `grep` over `.slicer/slices/*.json`, which means parsing slicer's storage by hand,
which is the thing the tool exists to stop you doing.

This bites agents hardest: "is there already an item about X?" is the first question
before adding anything, and today it cannot be asked.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
`slicer find PATTERN [--in title,findings,body] [--json]`, returning items. Reuse
`store.load`; no index needed at this size. Consider whether `list` should grow
`--match` instead of adding a verb — one filter surface is easier to remember.

**Not in this slice:** an index or any dependency; a linear scan is fine for thousands of
items.
